reasoning: On the season so far the Spurs are the stronger team; with home court the Spurs start about 16 points better, in a game of about 233 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Spurs.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Spurs win 94 times in 100, by about 18; most games like this end between 207 and 256 total points.
